title: Category (Category-Level)
description: A product category/family belonging to a company. Imports its own structure/ and strategies/, mirroring the family's warehouse.yaml/order_type.yaml/allocation.yaml pattern.

api_version.description: Schema generation this category document conforms to. Declared on the category because that is this repo's self-contained, independently loadable scope - the same role warehouse.yaml plays in Topology-as-Code. A future incompatible change to this repo's schemas raises the version instead of silently reinterpreting existing data.

default_attributes.description: Shared attributes every item in this category inherits unless it overrides them - same pattern as Topology-as-Code's storage_type.default_attributes -> storage_point exceptions.

imports.description: Relative paths to further YAML files (structure/, strategies/).
